name: Al Romaih Investment
note: Real-estate investment firm; its droplet logo and name (للاستثمارات العقارية) sit across the upper back of Al-Fayha's 2026-27 shirt (club store product photos). Al-Jazirah (2016) names Tariq Al Romaih as general manager of Al Romaih Real Estate Investment Company; club honorary member Tariq bin Abdullah Al Romaih also funds the club. No open record names the owner.
